message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need to know | |---------|-----------------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house rule you set). Points are earned by being the first to finish a round and by collecting the cards left in opponents’ hands. | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each (two 0’s, two 1–9, two “Draw Two”, two “Skip”, two “Reverse”, two “Wild”, two “Wild Draw Four”). | | **Setup** | 1. Shuffle the deck.
2. Deal 7 cards to each player.
3. Place the remaining deck face‑down as the draw pile.
4. Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a “Draw Two,” the first player draws two cards and loses their turn). | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a “Reverse” changes direction). On your turn you may:
• **Play** one card that matches the color, number, or symbol of the top discard card.
• **Play** a Wild or Wild Draw Four (any color).
• **Draw** one card from the draw pile if you cannot play. If the drawn card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Special Cards** | • **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and skips their turn.
• **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses play direction.
• **Wild** – Player chooses the next color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – Player chooses the next color; next player draws four cards and skips their turn. (Can only be played if you have no matching color; otherwise you risk a challenge.) | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you play your second‑to‑last card, shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player notices before the next turn starts, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards all their cards. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of the cards left in opponents’ hands: numbers = face value, Draw Two/Skip/Reverse = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **Winning the Game** | First player to reach 500 points (or your chosen target) wins. | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Keep an eye on the discard pile** – Knowing what cards are out helps you plan your plays. 2. **Use Wilds strategically** – Save them for when you’re stuck or to force opponents into a tough spot. 3. **Watch for “Draw Four” challenges** – If you suspect a player is cheating, you can challenge them; if they were forced to play it, they must draw 8 cards instead of 4. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
